name: SAINTOS MEGA AGENT - 01 CEO COMMAND CENTER

parameters.content:
# SaintOS Mega Agent

CEO AI Agent -> Manager Agents -> Specialist Workers

Built by Saint Sauveur N'Guessan for n8n AI automation portfolio.

## Input Channels

Gmail, WhatsApp, Telegram, Voice and client portal events enter here.

## Message Normalization

Convert every channel into one canonical payload.

## CEO AI Agent

SaintOS CEO reasons over context, memory, priority and risk.

## Manager Routing

Structured output routes to specialized managers.

## Memory + Approval

RAG, audit and human approval protect every external action.

## Output Channels

Responses are drafted for approval before sending.

## Monitoring

Errors and execution context are saved for debugging.

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({json: {...item.json, normalized: true, receivedAt: new Date().toISOString()}}));
return items.map(item => ({json: {...item.json, contactId: item.json.email || item.json.phone || item.json.chatId || 'demo-contact'}}));
return items.map(item => ({json: {...item.json, memoryLoaded: true, ceoInputReady: true}}));

options.systemMessage: You are SaintOS CEO Agent built by Saint Sauveur N'Guessan. Route every request to the right manager. Never approve external actions yourself. Return structured JSON with intent, manager, priority, risk, summary, worker_task, recommended_channel and approval_required.

parameters.name: communication_manager
parameters.description: Routes Gmail, WhatsApp, Telegram and voice replies through channel-specific workers.

parameters.name: client_success_manager
parameters.description: Qualifies leads, drafts proposals, handles objections, builds quotes and prepares follow-ups.

parameters.name: research_manager
parameters.description: Runs web research, company enrichment, competitor analysis, source summarization and report writing.

parameters.name: operations_manager
parameters.description: Updates Google Sheets, Notion, Calendar, PostgreSQL and task tracking systems after approval.

parameters.name: content_manager
parameters.description: Creates LinkedIn posts, blog articles, portfolio case studies, video scripts and Upwork profile copy.

parameters.name: voice_manager
parameters.description: Handles voice-call transcripts, spoken reply drafts, call summaries and follow-up actions.

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({json: {...item.json, manager: item.json.manager || 'communication', risk: item.json.risk || 'approval_required', priority: item.json.priority || 'normal'}}));
return items.map(item => ({json: {...item.json, priorityScore: item.json.priority === 'urgent' ? 100 : item.json.priority === 'high' ? 75 : 40}}));
return items.map(item => ({json: {...item.json, approvalRequired: item.json.risk !== 'safe'}}));

description: Visual command center for SaintOS Mega Agent, a multi-agent n8n AI operating system built by Saint Sauveur N'Guessan.
